params.body:
The withheld answer counted both numbers in one expression where a dot meets a plus. PHP 8 binds the plus tighter, so the sum was right, but a count in a product about what you can prove should be obvious rather than depend on the reader knowing a precedence rule. It is a sprintf now, and the empty case says how many sources there are rather than only that none is withheld.

Two numbers, both tested.
params.title: Een telling is duidelijk, niet slim
